note: A mixin's field initializer changes. AOT copies the mixin's members into each class that applies it, here dart:mixin_deduplication's &Base&Counter, and a patch cannot replace that copy, so the patch is refused and names the copy's constructor. The frozen reference tooling compares procedures only and calls this inert, so it is not a witness here.
rejectionReasons: this constructor, an instance field initializer it runs, or a constant argument that every caller passes it changed; a patch replaces method bodies only, so the release keeps running its own
